provenance: Hand-authored contrast cases inspired by prior operational failure modes; not generated by RSSCollector. Synthetic diagnostic examples, not market evidence.

cases.title: President touts a $54 billion pipeline
cases.rationale: Political announcement; billion is not legislation. Unnamed roles are excluded from named entities.

cases.title: Pilot injured in physical attack
cases.rationale: Physical harm, no cyber incident or market direction.

cases.title: Together Canada reviews its Golden Week calendar and metadata
cases.rationale: Canada is a named country; no ADA, ETH, GOLD or META asset mentions.

cases.title: Weekly bulletin
cases.rationale: HTML attributes are not article text.

cases.title: Bitcoin wallet hacked: funds stolen
cases.rationale: Actual theft is explicitly adverse for the named asset; not a future return claim.

cases.title: SEC announces new regulatory compliance rules
cases.rationale: Regulation without stated market direction.

cases.title: Bitcoin did not surge; its price was unchanged
cases.rationale: Surge explicitly negated; unchanged is neutral.

cases.title: Ethereum did not crash; its price was unchanged
cases.rationale: Crash explicitly negated.

cases.title: Bitcoin wallet was not hacked; no funds were stolen
cases.rationale: Denial of incident is news, not an asserted exploit; no directional price statement.

cases.title: SEC did not approve the Bitcoin ETF; the application is still pending
cases.rationale: Pending regulatory process remains regulatory; direction unstated.

cases.title: Hospital confirms no ransomware incident occurred
cases.rationale: Negated incident; unnamed hospital is not a named entity.

cases.title: Bitcoin is not bullish: price outlook remains bearish
cases.rationale: Explicit bearish outlook; bullish is negated.

cases.title: Pilot injured in attack; Bitcoin wallet software gets an update
cases.rationale: Attack and wallet belong to different topics; no cyber incident.

cases.title: SEC announces regulation; Fed announces interest rate decision
cases.rationale: Two explicit event types; neither should erase the other.

cases.title: Bitcoin surge; Ethereum plunge
cases.rationale: Opposite asset directions: one global sentiment is unscorable, not neutral.

cases.title: AAPL earnings beat estimates; president announces election
cases.rationale: Positive earnings direction plus political topic without asset direction.

cases.title: President gives strong speech; Bitcoin price unchanged
cases.rationale: Strong modifies speech, not market direction.

cases.title: Gold rally while oil falls
cases.rationale: Opposite commodity directions; scalar sentiment is not defined.

cases.title: Bitcoin BTC and Ethereum ETH prices unchanged
cases.rationale: Aliases identify two unique assets.

cases.title: btc and eth prices unchanged
cases.rationale: Lowercase ticker mentions explicitly refer to prices.

cases.title: Apple Inc. earnings beat estimates
cases.rationale: Named listed issuer and positive earnings; canonical ticker AAPL.

cases.title: ADA accessibility compliance bill advances
cases.rationale: ADA is the accessibility law, not Cardano; named laws count as entities.

cases.title: Bitcoin surges to a new peak
cases.rationale: Inflected surge still explicitly reports upward direction.

cases.title: Ethereum crashes as its price plunges
cases.rationale: Inflected verbs explicitly report downward direction.
